text: Keep AI on track with five habits.
Write the requirements down, and actually read them. Define how you’ll verify the result before building. Agree the design. Work in phases, each with a check. And turn conventions into rules.
Every unanswered question is a place the AI improvises. Answer them first, and improvising becomes executing.
Sensei scores how deep your plan was, flags when work leaves it, and turns what you keep correcting into rules.
